hints.title: Circular Array Traversal
hints.text: Because the array is circular, traversing indices up to twice the array length allows evaluating shortest circular distances between identical elements in a linear manner.

hints.title: Last Seen Precomputation
hints.text: Keep track of the last seen position of each number during a doubled linear scan from 0 to 2n - 1.

hints.title: Answer Queries in Constant Time
hints.text: Whenever an identical number is encountered, compute the distance from its previous position and update the minimum circular distance for both positions.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Precomputation requires two passes over the array and queries are answered in O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning the array linearly for each query takes O(N * Q) which times out.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Precomputing minimum distances in an array of size N eliminates search during queries.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that circular distance between identical values can be computed by doubling the iteration range.
